item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prevent it from being built.

2. We cannot accept a race toward catastrophe. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will kill at least a billion people. We are working for a ban on superintelligence.

3. We want a future in which humanity survives and thrives. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must stop that future before it starts.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are working to prevent a catastrophe: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will kill at least a billion people. We cannot treat that outcome as an acceptable price of technological progress. We cannot leave humanity’s future to a race among companies competing to build systems more capable than any human. At MIRI, we are focused on communications and policy toward a ban on superintelligence. We want a future in which people can live, build, discover, and flourish—not one in which those possibilities are destroyed. We must stop superintelligence from being built, and we are working to make that happen.
